== Full deck lists and new version articles (10 November 2026) ==
=== Build notes ===
* Card list now shows the eight premiums (seven exclusives plus the white-border Jedi Pack Leia), then each side's full 60-card deck with copy counts (Light 32 titles, Dark 29 titles; 61 titles, 120 cards). Decipher's [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/esbtwoplayer/esb2playercardlist.pdf Two-Player Deck Card Lists] ([https://web.archive.org/web/19990908013557/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/esbtwoplayer/esb2playercardlist.pdf Preserved copy]), the rules booklet p. 16, [https://nslists.com/swccgesb.htm House of Checklists] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20181112172013/http://www.nslists.com:80/swccgesb.htm Preserved copy]) and Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 pp. 85–86 agree title for title; the Encyclopedia omits only the © 1995 Light Side Restraining Bolt. Ticket swccg-guild/work#252.
* New articles for the 52 © 1996 reprints, titled <code>Title (ESB Two-Player)</code> (Dark copies of shared titles keep <code>(Dark)</code> before it), GEMP <code>61_n</code> / <code>62_n</code> / <code>63_n</code> (60 + the base set, same card number, <code>o</code> where the black-border article's printed face is <code>o</code>), and [[Leia (ESB Two-Player)]] (<code>104_8</code>), separate from black-border [[Leia (Jedi Pack)]] (<code>102_3</code>). Ids as approved in swccg-guild/work#113. Game text, lore and stats come from the black-border article of each card (Limited-era text, Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 30). The Light Side Restraining Bolt (© 1995) links [[Restraining Bolt (Unlimited)]].
* The 15 October 2026 Style pass entry above now links the Preserved copy of the starwarsccg.org Collecting page instead of the live site.
* Removed the unsourced "6th Star Wars CCG product" wording (Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 does not number the products, and its timeline lists more than five English products before this box). Fixed the repeated Light Side sentence on [[Hoth: Mountains (6th Marker)]].
=== Missing data ===
* No face of an Empire Strikes Back Two-Player © 1996 reprint or of the white-border Leia has been opened for these articles, so they have no image, and Set icon is blank on the 37 A New Hope and Hoth reprints and on Leia. The 15 Premiere reprints show Set icon none (Premiere cards print no expansion icon).
* The black-border, Unlimited and Revised articles do not yet list the new <code>(ESB Two-Player)</code> versions in their Versions rows.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Rarity of the exclusives: Decipher's list and the booklet say "Common and only in The Empire Strikes Back Two-Player Game"; Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 says Premium (PM).
* The booklet and Decipher's list print "I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookie"; the card title is [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee (ESB Two-Player)|I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]].
* House of Checklists says all cards show a 1996 copyright date; Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 p. 30 says the Light Side Restraining Bolt is © 1995.
* Booster: Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 Set Information says Premiere "(Unlimited)"; its box diagram says "(Limited or Unlimited)".
* Count: Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 counts 60 English cards (it omits the © 1995 Restraining Bolt); the decks hold 61 titles.
